title: Leave a job running and return
fixture: Synthetic command deliberately exits7 on the CI Linux host; real server runner, durable receipts and Android notifications

beats.title: Review the exact job
beats.narration: Review the command and destination before starting. This test deliberately exits with code seven, so we can verify a failure result.

beats.title: Read the actual exit result
beats.narration: The result comes from the real server process. Failed, exit seven. Its output and saved status remain available after reconnecting.

beats.title: Return through the notification
beats.narration: Android shows the actual job result. Tap its notification to reopen the saved job in PocketShell.
